title: Fractional CISO for SaaS and Industrial IoT Companies
author: AikiField
exact_source_text: Security leadership before you need a full-time CISO. When enterprise customers, insurers, or your own team start asking difficult security questions, AikiField gives you experienced CISO-level leadership without the cost and delay of a full-time hire. Series A and B SaaS, AI, product, and industrial IoT companies · Wellington and remote engagements. Security has become a business problem. You may not need a permanent CISO. But you may need someone who can take responsibility for security now. Perhaps a major customer has sent a security questionnaire that your engineers do not have time to complete. Perhaps a sales opportunity is waiting on answers your team cannot confidently provide. Perhaps cyber-insurance requirements have exposed gaps that nobody has the capacity to organize.
